page_title: BUR 1-4 CHE | Burnley v Chelsea 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Stuart Attwell has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.
90+7' Burnley will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+7' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Lyle Foster (Burnley), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.

90+3' It could have been a good chance to score! Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) fails to release Nicolas Jackson with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears. The linesman signals a throw-in for Chelsea.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
88' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) tries to find Nicolas Jackson, but he puts too much power on the pass.
86' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) replaces Cole Palmer.
86' The ball is cleared after Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch so that Raheem Sterling can be given a rest.
82' Burnley will take a corner kick.

82' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Robert Sanchez pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
82' The referee points to the corner flag and Burnley will take a corner.
82' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
80' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) as his effort only hit the wall.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is coming onto the pitch as Wilson Odobert cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Burnley have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
79' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) commits a foul after dangerous play.
78' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
77' The current number of shots on goal is 2:5.

74' 1 - 4 Goal! Cole Palmer displays great vision and sends a pass to Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:4.
74' Yellow card! It's like Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Stuart Attwell agrees and books him.
71' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
70' The ball is cleared after Luca Koleosho (Burnley) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Burnley will have a throw-in.
68' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Chelsea players have a reason to celebrate!
67' The Chelsea players halt their celebrations as referee Stuart Attwell makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
65' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) receives a precise pass inside the box from Conor Gallagher and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josh Cullen departs the field of play to be replaced by Aaron Ramsey (Burnley).
61' Here is a change. Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Luca Koleosho (Burnley).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Connor Roberts (Burnley) will replace Vitinho.
59' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Burnley.
53' The possession of the ball – 35:65.
50' 1 - 2 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past James Trafford into the bottom right corner.
49' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
49' Poor challenge! Vitinho (Burnley) is penalised for tripping and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Chelsea!
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Ameen Al Dakhil comes off for Dara O'Shea (Burnley).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Mauricio Pochettino gives a chance to Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) and Armando Broja is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Referee Stuart Attwell halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Mauricio Pochettino, then shows him a yellow.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Armando Broja (Chelsea) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
45+2' Yellow card. Thiago Silva (Chelsea) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
45+1' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) attempts to feed Armando Broja with a chip pass, but James Trafford reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' A pass lands at the feet of Armando Broja (Chelsea) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
42' 1 - 1 Ameen Al Dakhil (Burnley) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!
41' Now Chelsea have a corner.
41' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
39' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but James Trafford intercepts the ball.
38' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
38' The foul by Wilson Odobert (Burnley) was seen by Stuart Attwell who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

37' The opposition back off Raheem Sterling (Chelsea), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but James Trafford denies him with the save.
35' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) sends a cross in and finds Raheem Sterling inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.

33' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
32' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
32' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) plays a long ball to Enzo Fernandez, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
30' Josh Cullen (Burnley) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
30' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
27' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Stuart Attwell didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to James Trafford, who smothers the ball.
22' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) whips the ball into the box and Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
22' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends a chip pass into the box, but James Trafford is quickest to intercept the ball.
20' A pass by Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Lyle Foster plays a simple square pass into the feet of Wilson Odobert (Burnley) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
14' Great solo effort from Raheem Sterling (Chelsea)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.
12' Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
11' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
8' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) picks up a long through ball, but James Trafford deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
7' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
6' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but James Trafford comes off his line to gather the ball.
4' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
2' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell will officiate today.
